# Manifest template

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

For your convenience, this is a display of the manifest JSON with some sample data. For details, see the respective articles about each section.

## Best practice: always use the latest version

It is very important that you use the latest version of the manifest template, or else it may fail validation.
The best practice is to download the latest template from the app creation screen.

![](/img/create-app-from-manifest-July2026.png)

For more information, see the [Manifest overview](/docs/build-flow/manifests/#create-an-app).
